name: Disneyland Carnation Café Roasted Turkey Club Sandwich on Toasted Sourdough
brandOrRestaurant: Carnation Café (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Stacks lean roasted turkey breast, bacon, and creamy avocado on toasted sourdough bread for a reliable sit-down lunch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Club on sourdough with mayo on the side and ask to hold the raw tomatoes and shredded iceberg lettuce.
watchOuts: Skip the fried pickles starter and ask for no raw tomato/lettuce on the sandwich
